DiskExpansionAndTypeChange.clientToken: Idempotency token, an ASCII string of no more than 64 characters. See [ClientToken Idempotency](BCC/API参考/通用说明.md#幂等性) for details.
DiskExpansionAndTypeChange.newCdsSizeInGB: New capacity for the expanded CDS disk. Must be an integer greater than the current CDS capacity, in GB, a positive integer ranging from 0 to 32765 GB.
DiskExpansionAndTypeChange.newExtraIO: Adjusted extra IOPS count. Supports both upgrading and downgrading. newVolumeType, newCdsSizeInGB, and newExtraIO cannot all be empty at the same time.
DiskExpansionAndTypeChange.newVolumeType: CDS supports upgrading and downgrading both prepaid and postpaid cloud disks. newVolumeType and newCdsSizeInGB cannot both be empty at the same time.
DiskExpansionAndTypeChange.newVolumeType.hdd: General Purpose HDD (this type is being gradually phased out)
DiskExpansionAndTypeChange.newVolumeType.sata: Previous-generation cloud disk, dedicated to creating DCC sub-instances
DiskExpansionAndTypeChange.newVolumeType.local_ssd: Data stored on local SSD disk, with low latency and good IO and throughput capabilities. Suitable for medium to large relational database workloads.
DiskExpansionAndTypeChange.newVolumeType.local_hdd 或 std1: Local HDD disk, suitable for large-scale data storage scenarios
DiskExpansionAndTypeChange.newVolumeType.local_nvme 或 nvme: Local NVME disk. Data stored on local NVME SSD disk, with ultra-high performance. Suitable for latency-sensitive workloads.
